title: Validity of snapshot sources
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $\ell$ be a finite list of bit sources, and let $T,t,n$ be natural numbers. Every source in the snapshot-source list for $M$, $\ell$, and time $t$ is valid for input width $n$, configuration width equal to the number of possible snapshots of $M$ plus five, and block index corresponding to time $t$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
A finite list of bit sources $\ell$
A source belonging to the snapshot-source list for $M$, $\ell$, and time $t$
